tasks.title: Confirm safe scope and required access

verification.title: Verify the queue name is non-confidential
verification.instruction: Inspect the chosen queue name before creating the queue.
verification.expectedResult: The name is sqs-beginner-test and contains no sensitive information.

verification.title: Verify queue creation
verification.instruction: Inspect the page displayed after creating the queue.
verification.expectedResult: The Details page for sqs-beginner-test is displayed.

verification.title: Verify message submission
verification.instruction: Inspect the confirmation shown after sending the message.
verification.expectedResult: The Console displays a message-sent success confirmation.

tasks.title: Receive and inspect the test message

verification.title: Verify the received message
verification.instruction: Inspect the Messages section after polling.
verification.expectedResult: The received test message shows a Message ID, Sent date, Size, and Receive count.

verification.title: Verify deletion confirmation
verification.instruction: Inspect the Messages section after confirming deletion.
verification.expectedResult: The selected test message is no longer shown.

verification.title: Verify lifecycle understanding
verification.expectedResult: It states that a queue can be deleted even when it is not empty.

guidancePreservedFromStage6.task-sqs-receive-and-inspect-the-test-me: A future CLI path must retain the ReceiptHandle returned by receive-message for the later delete-message command.
guidancePreservedFromStage6.task-sqs-delete-the-received-test-messag: A future CLI path must use the most recently returned ReceiptHandle with delete-message.
guidancePreservedFromStage6.task-sqs-review-queue-deletion-effects-0: A future CLI cleanup path may use delete-queue only in Stage 8.
guidancePreservedFromStage6.task-sqs-confirm-safe-scope-and-required: A future CLI path may use --region eu-west-2 and must still rely on access already granted by the learner's administrator.

manualReviewFindings: An exact least-privilege policy must not be inferred. The learner must use an account or role already authorized for the required SQS Console actions.
Standard queues use at-least-once delivery and can occasionally return messages out of order; use one harmless test message and do not claim exactly-once or ordered delivery.
A Console-retrieved message is not deleted automatically and must be selected and deleted after verification.
FIFO-only requirements remain outside this standard-queue Follow Along.
Receipt-handle capture is preserved only for a future CLI path and is not required by the Console instructions.
Stage 6 provides queue lifecycle awareness only; actual manual queue deletion belongs to Stage 8 cleanup.

The accepted sources identify SQS permissions and actions but do not support an exact Console-only inspection that proves the signed-in identity has every required permission before performing the tasks.
The accepted Console receive/delete documentation does not support capturing a receipt handle in the Console; no transient receipt-handle resource was captured.
